messages.Too many rows; only part of the period w: Too many rows; only part of the period was read.

The end date is before the start date.
messages.Add at least one ad set (who sees the ad: Add at least one ad set (who sees the ads).
messages.Add at least one ad with a text and a he: Add at least one ad with a text and a headline.

messages.Write a short brief: what the campaign i: Write a short brief: what the campaign is for and who it should reach.
messages.The AI answer could not be read; try aga: The AI answer could not be read; try again.
messages.No payment from this contact came throug: No payment from this contact came through an ad.
messages.Turned on but the ID is missing or not v: Turned on but the ID is missing or not valid. Nothing is tracked.
messages.Browser pixel only. Without the server k: Browser pixel only. Without the server key, bank-transfer donations approved later and visitors with ad blockers are not counted.
messages.Pixel and server events are set up. Last: Pixel and server events are set up. Last test passed.
messages.Pixel and server events are set up. Run: Pixel and server events are set up. Run "Test" once to check the key.
messages.No ad platform is on. The ad report stil: No ad platform is on. The ad report still works from UTM links and click IDs.
messages.Not read yet; opening the Flux Ads scree: Not read yet; opening the Flux Ads screen starts it.
messages.The theme cookie banner is off, so ad pi: The theme cookie banner is off, so ad pixels load without asking. Under KVKK/GDPR marketing cookies need consent: turn the banner on in Appearance › Theme Settings.
You are not allowed to view this page.
messages.Which ad, campaign and ad text brought w: Which ad, campaign and ad text brought which donation. Paid donations and orders only; bank transfers count when approved.

Audience created in Meta and filled.
messages.Lookalike audience created. Meta fills i: Lookalike audience created. Meta fills it within a few hours.
messages.Flux AI wrote a draft. Read and edit it: Flux AI wrote a draft. Read and edit it before sending it to Meta.
messages.Created in Meta, paused. Turn it on unde: Created in Meta, paused. Turn it on under Campaigns when you are ready.
Sent again. The row shows the result.
messages.Some payments are in another currency an: Some payments are in another currency and no exchange rate was found; their amount is shown per currency in the row but not added to the totals. Install Flux CRM for currency conversion.
messages.No paid donation or order in this period: No paid donation or order in this period yet. Use the Ad link tab to tag your ads.
messages.Enter the ad account ID in Settings › Me: Enter the ad account ID in Settings › Meta. Spend per campaign and ad is then read every 6 hours, so the report shows ROAS and cost per donation.
messages.Not read yet. It runs in the background: Not read yet. It runs in the background after this page loads; refresh in a minute.
messages.The key needs the ads_read permission on: The key needs the ads_read permission on this ad account: Business Settings › Users › System users › add the ad account › Generate token (ads_read).
messages.Spend is matched to donations by campaig: Spend is matched to donations by campaign name (utm_campaign) and ad name (utm_content). Use the Meta URL parameters from the Ad link tab so the names are the same.
messages.For Google Ads, TikTok, posters or anyth: For Google Ads, TikTok, posters or anything not read automatically. Use the same campaign name as in the ad link.
You are not allowed to do this.
messages.What the people an ad brought in gave in: What the people an ad brought in gave in total, not only their first payment. A campaign whose first gifts are cheap but never come back shows up here.
messages.Nobody made a first payment in this peri: Nobody made a first payment in this period yet.
messages.A person belongs to the campaign of thei: A person belongs to the campaign of their first payment. Their later payments count for that campaign even when they came back without an ad. CAC is the campaign spend in this period divided by the new people it brought. Value / cost above 3x is good; below 1x the ad has not paid for itself yet.
messages.Value by month of first payment: Value by month of first payment
messages.Each row is the people who paid for the: Each row is the people who paid for the first time that month. The cells show what one person gave in total by the end of each month since then.
messages.Send a group of people from Flux CRM to: Send a group of people from Flux CRM to Meta as an audience: to show ads to similar people, or to stop showing ads to people who just donated. Only people who gave ad consent are sent, as encrypted (hashed) email and phone. The list is updated every day; someone who withdraws consent is removed straight away.
messages.Audiences need Flux CRM: people, ad cons: Audiences need Flux CRM: people, ad consent and segments come from there.
messages.Enter the Meta ad account ID and a Marke: Enter the Meta ad account ID and a Marketing API key with the ads_management permission in Settings › Meta.
messages.The audience is deleted in Meta too. Ad: The audience is deleted in Meta too. Ad sets that use it stop reaching these people.
messages.Also create a lookalike audience (people: Also create a lookalike audience (people similar to this group)
messages.Meta needs at least 100 matched people f: Meta needs at least 100 matched people for a lookalike. 1% is the closest match; larger sizes reach more people with less similarity.
"%s" stops showing in Meta right away. You can turn it back on any time.
messages.\"%s\" starts showing in Meta and spendi: "%s" starts showing in Meta and spending its budget.
messages.The daily budget of \"%1$s\" changes in: The daily budget of "%1$s" changes in Meta right away (now %2$s).
messages.Your Meta campaigns, ad sets and ads wit: Your Meta campaigns, ad sets and ads with spend and the donations they brought on this site. Pause, turn on or change the daily budget here; every change goes to Meta at once and is written to the history below.
messages.Enter the Meta ad account ID and a Marke: Enter the Meta ad account ID and a Marketing API key in Settings › Meta. Reading needs ads_read; pausing and budget changes need ads_management.
No campaigns in this ad account.
messages.Donations on the site are matched by cam: Donations on the site are matched by campaign name or ID in the ad link (utm_campaign). Meta numbers are refreshed every 10 minutes.
messages.Flux AI writes a campaign draft from you: Flux AI writes a campaign draft from your brief and this site's numbers: ad sets, audiences, budget split and ad text variants. You read and edit it here. "Send to Meta" creates everything paused; nothing is shown or spent until you turn it on under Campaigns.
messages.You can write drafts now. To send them t: You can write drafts now. To send them to Meta, add: %s.
messages.Flux AI is not ready. Install Flux AI &: Flux AI is not ready. Install Flux AI & MCP and add a model key, or start from an empty draft.
messages.e.g. Sapling campaign for November; reac: e.g. Sapling campaign for November; reach people like our donors in Istanbul and Ankara, leave out people who donated this month.
messages.Only the draft here is deleted. The paus: Only the draft here is deleted. The paused campaign stays in Meta.
messages.Headline: Headline
messages.This draft is in Meta as a paused campai: This draft is in Meta as a paused campaign. Turn it on or change it under Campaigns; to try a new version, duplicate it.
messages.Name: Name
messages.Each variant runs in every ad set, so Me: Each variant runs in every ad set, so Meta can find the text that works best.
messages.A paused campaign with %1$d ad sets and: A paused campaign with %1$d ad sets and %2$d ads is created in Meta. Nothing is shown or spent until you turn it on under Campaigns.
messages.Save your edits first. Ads open the page: Save your edits first. Ads open the page with UTM tags, so donations show up in the report and under Campaigns.
messages.no consent, or sent from the browser: no consent, or sent from the browser
messages.Nothing sent yet. When a donation is pai: Nothing sent yet. When a donation is paid, a Purchase event is sent to every platform that has its server key.
messages.Tag each ad with its own link: Tag each ad with its own link
messages.Meta, Google and TikTok add their click: Meta, Google and TikTok add their click ID by themselves. A UTM link also names the campaign and the ad, so the report can show "which ad brought which donation". Paste the link as the ad's website URL; use a different "Ad" value for each ad or video.
messages.Meta tip: instead of one link per ad you: Meta tip: instead of one link per ad you can put this in the ad's URL parameters field: utm_source={{site_source_name}}&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign={{campaign.name}}&utm_content={{ad.name}}
messages.Events Manager › Data sources › your pix: Events Manager › Data sources › your pixel › Settings.
messages.Events Manager › Settings › Conversions: Events Manager › Settings › Conversions API › Generate access token. Needed for server events (bank transfers, ad blockers).
messages.While testing only. Empty it after testi: While testing only. Empty it after testing, or real donations are reported as test events.
messages.Ads Manager › account menu at the top le: Ads Manager › account menu at the top left, the number under the account name (act_ is optional).
messages.The page Studio ads are published as. Pa: The page Studio ads are published as. Page › About › Page transparency › Page ID.
messages.Business Settings › Users › System users: Business Settings › Users › System users › add the ad account › Generate token. ads_read is enough for spend; audiences, Campaigns changes and Studio drafts need ads_management. Empty = the Conversions API token is tried. Flux Ads changes your ad account only when you approve it: an audience, a pause or budget change, or a Studio draft (always created paused).
messages.TikTok Ads Manager › Tools › Events › We: TikTok Ads Manager › Tools › Events › Web events.
messages.Pixel › Settings › Events API › Generate: Pixel › Settings › Events API › Generate access token.
messages.Empty = the theme's ID (%s). The theme a: Empty = the theme's ID (%s). The theme already loads the tag; Flux Ads only adds the donation events.
messages.Data stream › Measurement Protocol API s: Data stream › Measurement Protocol API secrets › Create. Needed for bank-transfer donations approved later. To see donations in Google Ads, import the GA4 "purchase" conversion there.
messages.Wait for consent (recommended): pixels a: Wait for consent (recommended): pixels and the ad cookie start only after the visitor accepts the theme cookie banner. Donations of visitors who did not accept are counted in the report but not sent to ad platforms.
Always: you collect consent another way.
messages.Only for contacts with ad consent in Flu: Only for contacts with ad consent in Flux CRM (recommended). Sent as SHA-256 hashes, never in plain text.
messages.Never: only the browser ID, IP and brows: Never: only the browser ID, IP and browser type.
messages.Always (hashed). Your privacy notice mus: Always (hashed). Your privacy notice must say so.
messages.Load the browser pixels too (page views,: Load the browser pixels too (page views, form and checkout steps). Off = server events only.
messages.How long a click counts for a later dona: How long a click counts for a later donation.
